name: Moab
bio: Moab is the son born to Lot's elder daughter after the destruction of Sodom, conceived in a cave with her father, and the ancestor of the Moabite people (Genesis 19:36-37). Despite this shameful and morally troubling origin, Moab's descendants would later be deeply woven into Israel's history — from Eglon, the Moabite king who oppressed Israel in the book of Judges, to Ruth, a Moabite woman who became the great-grandmother of King David.
